capabilities._note: Text only (no video: the sampler's `images` input left empty), 44.1 kHz. Judged on four places 2026-11-01 (docs/SOUND.md 'Measured: ambience beds'): the clear winner by ear (the diner's refrigerator hum far better than Stable Audio 3's), and the steadiest (the diner, rooftop and park within 0.5-1.8 dB second to second), so it loops best. Takes came out at -17 to -22 LUFS; a bed is brought to BED_LUFS when it lands (seriesmith/ambience.py). MIT (the weights and the node pack).

template._note: Seconds, as MMAudioSampler's duration takes them. A take is 10 s: the bed is its middle (1.5 s off each end), looped under the place's shots.

binding._note: kijai's ComfyUI-MMAudio, text to audio: MMAudioModelLoader (the large 44k v2 model, fp16), MMAudioFeatureUtilsLoader (its VAE, synchformer and CLIP, 44k mode; BigVGAN v2 is fetched by the pack on first use into models/mmaudio/nvidia), MMAudioSampler at 25 steps, cfg 4.5, SaveAudio (flac; the take is converted to wav and finished when it comes back). Validated on local ComfyUI 0.43, 2026-11-01.

final.negative: music, melody, singing, speech, talking, voices

downloads._note: The files ComfyUI-MMAudio's README points to (huggingface.co/Kijai/MMAudio_safetensors, listed 2026-11-01). Its node pack is https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-MMAudio (features.PACKS).
